text_block_list.text: One day, when I stopped by a ramen shop――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me, mister!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to help out with all I've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Actually, the shopkeeper threw his back 
out. So Tsuyu-chan and I decided to lend 
him a hand!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Thank you kindly. Tracel Academy really is 
full of wonderful children.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...! All right, Spe-chan will do the 
dishes then!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll go take out the trash!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whew~. Looks like that's the last of the 
trash. How are things on your end, 
Tsuru-chan—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Pheeew... whew...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Tsuru-chan?! Why are you so exhausted?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff... wheeze... I put... so much 
elbow grease into... scrubbing the pots, 
I'm out of breath...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hahh, whew…… S-Sor…… Let me rest…… *thud*.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry for making you worry! I'm 
totally fine now though! Back to doing the 
dishes, then!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! But what if you collapse 
again...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: The trick...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I see! Once you know the trick, you might 
not need to strain yourself so hard to 
wash them!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I see...! Please, do explain!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right! Feels like I've got the hang of 
it, so I'm gonna keep washing them one 
after another!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hup, hup, hup, hup! Neeext!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Doryaaah! All-all right, next pot!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—*pant*... *gasp*... *wheeze*... H-Huh...? 
Am I... starting to get tired... maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ts-Tsuru-chan! Don't you think you could 
take it easy now...!

Though Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi inevitably got 
overly fired up, she managed to see her 
duties through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right, customer service won't require 
heavy lifting! Tsuru-chan, leave the 
washing station to me and head over to 
greet the customers!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'm so sorry, causing you all this 
trouble...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Don't mind if I do! I'll go help out with 
customer service! Time to give it my all! 
Whoooo!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Welcooooome!! ...*cough*, ahem!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
One shoyu ramen, coming right uuuuup!!!! 
â*cough!* *hack!* *wheeze!*

Though frequently getting dizzy while 
serving customers, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi saw 
her helping duties through to the very 
end.
